Singletary played just five snaps on offense and took one carry for three yards in Thursday's 24-21 loss to the Commanders.
news.story: Cam Skattebo came back from a hamstring injury and dominated backfield work, taking 21 touches for 122 yards and two touchdowns on an 88 percent snap share. Singletary played 92 percent of snaps the week before in a win at Philadelphia, but his 23 touches went for just 39 total yards and no TDs. It'll likely be another large workload for Skattebo when the Giants host the Jaguars in Week 11.

news.headline: Likely didn't practice Friday due to a strained groin, but he doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game versus the Jaguars, Patricia Traina of SI.com reports.
news.story: There was some worry about the breakout tight end's status for Week 11 when he wasn't spotted at Friday's session, but head coach John Harbaugh allayed some of those fears, telling Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com that Likely was dealing with a "minor thing" and should be good to play Sunday. With no designation in tow, Likely is in the clear and probably is set for his typical 8.9 targets per game.

news.headline: Head coach John Harbaugh said Friday that Likely is tending to a "minor thing" but should be good to play Sunday against the Jaguars, Jordan Raanan of ESPN reports.
news.story: Likely appears poised to go down as a non-participant on the final practice report of this week due to an undisclosed injury. A designation ahead of Week 11 action thus seems likely for the tight end, which will become known later Friday.

news.story: That said, Duggan noted that he did see Likely, who hasn't been on the Giants' Week 11 injury report so far, walking into the building after the team's Friday morning walkthrough. In any case, New York's upcoming practice report will provide context regarding Likely's apparent absence, as well as his official status for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

news.story: In Fernando Mendoza's first career start at quarterback, Tucker saw just 6.9 percent of the targets, while Jack Bech led the team with seven looks. Tucker looks like someone who won't be usable in fantasy until he shows some tangible chemistry with the young quarterback.

news.story: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh previously noted that the QB "should be good to go" for Week 10 action after imaging on Herbert's injured left middle finger came back negative for a fracture, per ESPN.com. The fact that Herbert isn't listed in any way on the team's first injury report this week aligns with that and paves the way for him to continue to helm the offense for 0-8 Los Angeles versus Baltimore.

news.headline: Mooney caught two of five targets for eight yards Thursday in a loss to Washington.
news.story: Mooney logged the third-most targets of any New York pass catcher, but he managed just two short receptions. Efficiency has been an issue for the veteran wideout throughout the campaign, as he's hauled in only 14 of 30 targets through nine contests. Mooney has finished with fewer than 10 yards in four of his past six appearances, so he's not a viable fantasy play at the moment.

news.headline: Meyers (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
news.story: Meyers has been playing through the ankle injury for weeks, so his status was never in real doubt despite limited practices all week. The veteran wideout doesn't have a touchdown catch since Week 3 and has topped 65 receiving yards in a game just once all season. He's a low-floor, low-ceiling fantasy option.

news.headline: Meyers (ankle) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
news.story: Meyers had his reps capped for a second straight practice, but if he can maintain limited activity or upgrade to full participation Friday, he should be on track to play Sunday against the Giants. The veteran slot receiver has yet to miss a game this season, recording 29 receptions for 408 yards and two touchdowns on 43 targets through nine appearances.

news.headline: Meyers (ankle) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: The Jaguars have often kept Meyers limited early in the week since the veteran suffered an ankle injury, but he has yet to miss a game this year. There have even been weeks when Meyers did not practice Wednesday but still ended up playing. As it stands, Meyers' status will be worth monitoring for the rest of the week, but limited midweek work has been the norm for him.

The yardage tally also was a career-high figure for Harris, who generated team-high totals with all three components of his receiving line. Harris' volume projection for Week 10 partially depends on Ladd McConkey (back), who didn't play any snaps last week and didn't practice Thursday or Friday.

news.headline: Harris (shoulder) was a limited participant at practice Thursday.
